messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate detected for infer-service (us-east-1). 502/5xx spike at 3125008820 — paging oncall_alex. Metrics: 5xx rate 12% over 5m, p50 latency +30% :rotating_light:
oncall_alex: Ack. joining. any traceback or cluster events?
sre_jin: seeing repeated model-runner crashes on node gke-infer-3c, OOM killer messages and segfaults in model-runner process. stacktrace attached in logs.
eng_runtime_lee: grabbing logs now. pattern: crash happens during kv-cache restore on longseq requests. stack snippet: 
```
SIGSEGV at 0x7f8c3a12
backtrace: model_runner()+0x4f1, kv_cache_restore()+0x1ad
```
infra_nora: k8s events show oom_score_adj spikes and node-level memory pressure. Several pods restarted within 2m window. No node reboots.
sre_jin: quick scope — which model and seq len distribution? canary shows longseq tail increased (chatbot customer burst). model: gptx-13b-qa (quant).
eng_runtime_lee: hypothesis: quant decoder path + long KV restore causes allocator fragmentation leading to SIGSEGV. rolling fallback to float32 variant might avoid the crash.
oncall_alex: mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic from us-east-1 to us-west-2 for tiered customers, 2) scale up warm pool of non-quant model, 3) enable quick model-variant fallback in routing policy. I can flip routing for PRODUCTION tier.
prod_support_maya: customer_ops_sam — lobby says 3 enterprise customers reported timeouts in last 10m; clearly customer-facing.
customer_ops_sam: confirmed: customer A and B saw 504s, average timeout 10s, error rate ~9% for them. raised high-priority tickets.
sre_jin: running quick probe: curl against gateway -> 502s still ~11%. starting targeted reroute now.
oncall_alex: reroute started. executed: `rbctl route set infer-service --region us-east-1 --fallback-region us-west-2 --priority prod=100`
eng_runtime_lee: started canary rollout of float variant: `deployctl promote gptx-13b-float --env=dedicated --pool=warm` — warming KV caches.
infra_nora: added node-level memory guard: set eviction threshold to 0.88 and applied psp limit to runner pods to prevent noisy neighbor OOMs.
sre_jin: quick mitigation observation: after reroute and float rollout error rate dropped to 2.1% in us-east-1 but overall still 3.4% (some requests still hitting legacy pools). going to drain hot nodes with segfaults.
oncall_alex: draining affected nodes now: `kubectl cordon node/gke-infer-3c && kubectl drain node/gke-infer-3c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
eng_runtime_lee: added emergency hotpatch to disable KV restore for requests > 1024 tokens (will increase latency but avoids restore path). patch applied to runtime config: `kvcache.max_restore_tokens=1024`
prod_support_maya: communicated to customers: we are rerouting traffic and applying mitigations; next update in 15m.
customer_ops_sam: Customer A acknowledged workaround (retries helped), wants postmortem and ETA.
sre_jin: metrics update (3125010000): total 5xx now 0.9% (baseline 0.2%). us-east-1 5xx ~1.1%. rolling mitigations working.
oncall_alex: handing off to day oncall (eng_runtime_lee) for follow-ups and postmortem. key action items for day: collect core dumps, preserve node images, run reproducer on quant path, schedule model variant rollout to avoid KV restore for longseq burst.
eng_runtime_lee: ack, taking over. I'll coordinate with infra_nora to keep drained nodes under observation and with prod_support_maya for customer comms. will open a tracking ticket and attach logs + core dumps.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress — paging cleared. Escalation: none. Updates every 30m or on request. :white_check_mark:
